reasoning: Both meetings deliver a 25 basis point cut using identical justification language ('in light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures') and maintain the same 'act as appropriate to sustain the expansion' forward guidance, confirming continuation of the mid-cycle insurance-cutting regime established in July. The September cut moves the target range from 2–2.25% to 1.75–2%, which is an incremental step along the already-established easing trajectory rather than a new regime. The repo market stress and emergency overnight operations are a technical/operational development, not a strategic policy tool shift.
key_quote: In light of the implications of global developments for the economic outlook as well as muted inflation pressures, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate to 1-3/4 to 2 percent.
